description: The deeper profile for an area in England or Wales. With a free Praesago API key: about 30 sections (demographics, income, ethnicity, tenure, dwelling types, deprivation domains, health, schools, broadband, flood, noise, green space, council tax, politics, homelessness, local economy), each with its source year. Without a key you get the same headline facts as get_area_overview plus a note on what the key adds. Takes a postcode, a postcode district or a place name. England & Wales only. It describes the area as it is and does not forecast prices. Give a full postcode or a postcode sector (for example "E17 7") to also get the sold price of that sector (median only with 10 or more sales in 12 months).

area.description: A postcode ("E17 7AB"), postcode district ("E17") or place name ("Walthamstow", "Hackney")
